from scipy.optimize import least_squares
t=df['t'].values; P=df['P'].values; y=df['dP_dt'].values
def model(p):
    a,b,c0,c1,A,w,ph,d,k,e=p
    h=c0+c1*t+A*np.sin(w*t+ph)+d*np.exp(-k*t)+e*np.log(t)
    return a*t+b*P*np.log(P)+h/P
best=None

import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params
    s = np.sin(p[5]*t); c = np.cos(p[5]*t)
    h = p[2] + p[3]*t + p[4]*s + p[6]*c + p[7]*np.log(t) + p[8]*np.exp(-t) + p[9]*t*t
    return p[0]*t + p[1]*P*np.log(P) + h/P
